Join the ECE Faculty Prestigious PhD Alumni Database

As a PhD graduate of the Faculty of Electrical and Computer Engineering, you are part of an elite community shaping the future of engineering, science, and technology worldwide. Our graduates are at the forefront of innovation—pioneering research, launching groundbreaking startups, and making significant contributions to industry and academia.

We are building a dedicated database to highlight your achievements, foster professional connections, and showcase the impact of our doctoral alumni. This will be featured here, on the Faculty’s website and shared on LinkedIn and other social platforms, providing valuable networking and promotional opportunities.

Be part of this initiative—fill out the form and join a thriving network of excellence!
